Let's break this down month by month: - From October 1, 2022, to October 31, 2022: 30 - 1 + 1 = 31 - 1 = 30 days (since October 1 is the starting point, we count the remaining days in October). - November 2022 has 30 days. - December 2022 has 31 days. - January 2023 has 31 days. - February 2023 has 28 days (since 2023 is not a leap year). - March 2023 has 31 days. - April 2023 has 30 days. - May 2023 has 31 days. - From June 1 to June 13, 2023: 13 days. Now, let's add up all these days: \[ 30 \, (\text{October}) + 30 \, (\text{November}) + 31 \, (\text{December}) + 31 \, (\text{January}) + 28 \, (\text{February}) + 31 \, (\text{March}) + 30 \, (\text{April}) + 31 \, (\text{May}) + 13 \, (\text{June}) \] Let's sum them step by step: \[ 30 + 30 = 60 \] \[ 60 + 31 = 91 \] \[ 91 + 31 = 122 \] \[ 122 + 28 = 150 \] \[ 150 + 31 = 181 \] \[ 181 + 30 = 211 \] \[ 211 + 31 = 242 \] \[ 242 + 13 = 255 \] So, the total number of days between October 1, 2022, and June 13, 2023, is 255 days. Step 2: Convert the total number of days (255) into weeks and days. Since there are 7 days in a week, we divide 255 by 7 to get the number of weeks and the remainder will give us the number of days. \[ 255 \div 7 = 36 \, \text{weeks and a remainder of } 255 - (36 \times 7) \] Calculate \( 36 \times 7 \): \[ 36 \times 7 = 252 \] Now, find the remainder: \[ 255 - 252 = 3 \] So, 255 days is equal to 36 weeks and 3 days. Therefore, the estimated gestational age is 36 weeks and 3 days.
